        n, m, t = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    tp, tu, td = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    heights = [list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n)]

    def calculate_time(r1, c1, r2, c2):
        time = 0
        # top side
        for c in range(c1, c2):
            if heights[r1][c] == heights[r1][c + 1]:
                time += tp
            elif heights[r1][c] < heights[r1][c + 1]:
                time += tu
            else:
                time += td
        # right side
        for r in range(r1, r2):
            if heights[r][c2] == heights[r + 1][c2]:
                time += tp
            elif heights[r][c2] < heights[r + 1][c2]:
                time += tu
            else:
                time += td
        if r1 != r2 and c1 != c2:
            # bottom side
            for c in range(c2, c1, -1):
                if heights[r2][c] == heights[r2][c - 1]:
                    time += tp
                elif heights[r2][c] < heights[r2][c - 1]:
                    time += tu
                else:
                    time += td
            # left side
            for r in range(r2, r1, -1):
                if heights[r][c1] == heights[r - 1][c1]:
                    time += tp
                elif heights[r][c1] < heights[r - 1][c1]:
                    time += tu
                else:
                    time += td
        return time

    best_diff = float('inf')
    best_rectangle = None

    for r1 in range(n - 2):
        for c1 in range(m - 2):
            for r2 in range(r1 + 2, n):
                for c2 in range(c1 + 2, m):
                    ts = calculate_time(r1, c1, r2, c2)
                    diff = abs(ts - t)
                    if diff < best_diff:
                        best_diff = diff
                        best_rectangle = (r1 + 1, c1 + 1, r2 + 1, c2 + 1)

    print(best_rectangle[0], best_rectangle[1], best_rectangle[2], best_rectangle[3])

main()
